title: Instagram User Info
description: Fetch public Instagram profile information for up to 100 usernames in one cost-efficient run.

usernames.title: Instagram usernames
usernames.description: Recommended. Process multiple usernames in one Actor run so startup and storage overhead are shared across results. Duplicates are fetched once.

username.title: Legacy single Instagram username
username.description: Backward-compatible single username. Prefer usernames for normal usage, especially when processing more than one profile.
